prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right attorney depends on your location, the severity/complexity of your injuries, whether fault or police/insurance disputes are likely, and whether you want a lawyer who will take the case to trial or prefers to settle. I can help you find the right lawyer, but here are practical steps and a few well‑known Chicago plaintiff firms people commonly recommend:

How to pick the best attorney for your case
- Look for accident and wrongful‑injury specialization, not a general practice.
- Trial experience — a lawyer who will actually go to trial if insurers lowball.
- Strong track record in car-accident settlements/verdicts and client references.
- Good communication — they answer questions and explain strategy clearly.
- Contingency-fee arrangement (typically 33–40% of recovery) and clear fee terms.
- Positive peer ratings (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell), Avvo reviews, and no disciplinary history.
- Local courtroom experience and relationships with medical providers and accident reconstruction experts.

Chicago firms frequently recommended for car-accident/personal-injury work
- Clifford Law Offices
- Corboy & Demetrio
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Power Rogers & Smith
- Kralovec, Jambois & Schwartz

(These are examples of reputable Chicago plaintiff firms; I can look up more firms and recent client reviews for you.)

What to do next
- If you want, tell me your ZIP code and a short case summary (date, injuries, police report, insurance situation). I’ll compile a short list of well‑rated attorneys/firms in your area, with links to ratings and contact info.
- When you contact attorneys, ask: Do you handle car-accident cases full time? What is your trial rate? What contingency fee and costs policy do you use? Who will handle my case day-to-day?

If you want, give me your location and a few details about the crash and injuries and I’ll find 3–5 top-rated Chicago attorneys and summarize their strengths so you can choose who to call.
